nodes.description: Auth.add(address) external payable: adds an authority via AccountInterface.enable with no access control and no reentrancy guard.
Auth.remove(address) external payable: removes an authority via AccountInterface.disable with no access control and no reentrancy guard.
AccountInterface.enable(address) external function invoked on address(this).
AccountInterface.disable(address) external function invoked on address(this).
EventInterface.emitEvent(uint,uint,bytes32,bytes) external function called on the hardcoded event logger address.
Basics.getEventAddr() internal pure returns the hardcoded event logger address 0x2af7...bA97.
Basics.connectorID() public pure returns connector type 1 and id 10.
ConnectAuth.name public constant string 'Auth-v1'.
msg.sender read inside Auth.add and used as log sender and event payload without authorization.
msg.sender read inside Auth.remove and used as log sender and event payload without authorization.
External call AccountInterface(address(this)).enable(authority) in Auth.add, performed before any state/event bookkeeping and without access control.
External call EventInterface(getEventAddr()).emitEvent(...) in Auth.add with attacker-controlled authority in the payload.
External call AccountInterface(address(this)).disable(authority) in Auth.remove, callable by anyone.
External call EventInterface(getEventAddr()).emitEvent(...) in Auth.remove with attacker-controlled authority in the payload.
Parameter 'authority' of Auth.add(address authority).
Parameter 'authority' of Auth.remove(address authority).
Local bytes32 _eventCode = keccak256('LogAddAuth(address,address)') in Auth.add.
Local bytes _eventParam = abi.encode(msg.sender, authority) in Auth.add.
Local uint _type returned by connectorID() in Auth.add.
Local uint _id returned by connectorID() in Auth.add.
Local bytes32 _eventCode = keccak256('LogRemoveAuth(address,address)') in Auth.remove.
Local bytes _eventParam = abi.encode(msg.sender, authority) in Auth.remove.
Local uint _type returned by connectorID() in Auth.remove.
Local uint _id returned by connectorID() in Auth.remove.

edges.reason: Auth.add unconditionally invokes AccountInterface(address(this)).enable(authority) with no caller authorization.
Auth.add unconditionally invokes EventInterface.emitEvent after emitting the local event.
Auth.remove unconditionally invokes AccountInterface(address(this)).disable(authority) with no caller authorization.
Auth.remove unconditionally invokes EventInterface.emitEvent after emitting the local event.
Auth.add binds its incoming calldata argument to the authority parameter.
Auth.remove binds its incoming calldata argument to the authority parameter.
Caller-supplied authority parameter flows straight into the privileged enable() call, letting anyone grant authorities.
authority parameter is ABI-encoded into _eventParam.
msg.sender is ABI-encoded into _eventParam.
_eventCode is passed to the external emitEvent call in Auth.add.
_eventParam is passed to the external emitEvent call in Auth.add.
_type from connectorID() is passed to the external emitEvent call in Auth.add.
_id from connectorID() is passed to the external emitEvent call in Auth.add.
getEventAddr() supplies the target address for the emitEvent call in Auth.add.
connectorID() supplies _type and _id for the emitEvent call in Auth.add.
msg.sender is forwarded into the external emitEvent payload from Auth.add.
Auth.add trusts msg.sender as the log origin with no authorization check, enabling unauthorized authority additions.
Auth.remove trusts msg.sender as the log origin with no authorization check, enabling unauthorized authority removal.
Caller-supplied authority parameter flows into the privileged disable() call, letting anyone revoke authorities.
authority parameter is ABI-encoded into _eventParam in Auth.remove.
msg.sender is ABI-encoded into _eventParam in Auth.remove.
_eventCode is passed to the external emitEvent call in Auth.remove.
_eventParam is passed to the external emitEvent call in Auth.remove.
_type from connectorID() is passed to the external emitEvent call in Auth.remove.
_id from connectorID() is passed to the external emitEvent call in Auth.remove.
getEventAddr() supplies the target address for the emitEvent call in Auth.remove.
connectorID() supplies _type and _id for the emitEvent call in Auth.remove.
msg.sender is forwarded into the external emitEvent payload from Auth.remove.
The external enable() call occurs before the function completes, so a malicious callee can re-enter Auth.add (no reentrancy guard).
The external emitEvent() call can call back into Auth.add, which has no reentrancy protection.
The external disable() call can call back into Auth.remove, which has no reentrancy protection.
The external emitEvent() call can call back into Auth.remove, which has no reentrancy protection.
